files: Files are not part of an export. Attach them again in {{names}}.

partContentType: Multipart text fields in {{names}} set a content type, which Gostman sends only for file fields.

tooManyItems: Only the first {{count}} items were read; the rest were left out.

notRecognized: {{file}}: not a format Gostman imports (OpenAPI or Swagger, Postman, Insomnia, Bruno, HAR, .http, WSDL or a Gostman export)

unsafePath: "{{path}}" is not a safe path inside the collection
depth: Folders nested deeper than {{count}} levels were skipped.

httpVariables_one: The variable {{names}} has no Gostman equivalent and was kept as written.
httpVariables_other: The variables {{names}} have no Gostman equivalent and were kept as written.

httpBodyFile: Bodies in {{names}} include files with < path, which were not read. Paste the content again.
httpHandlerFile: Response handlers in {{names}} are separate .js files, which were not read. Copy them into the post-response script.
httpRedirect: Responses saved to files with >> in {{names}} are not saved by Gostman.
httpStream: {{name}}: {{method}} requests in .http files are not imported.
httpEnvironmentValue: {{file}}: the value of "{{key}}" in environment "{{environment}}" is not plain text and was left out.

protoMissing: The .proto file of {{names}} was not part of the import. Add it in the request's gRPC tab, or load the services through reflection.
maxRedirects: {{names}} limits the number of redirects, which Gostman does not; it follows up to 10.
grpcScripts: Gostman does not run the {{kinds}} scripts of {{label}}, so they were left out.
environmentExtends: Environment "{{name}}" inherits from "{{parent}}", which was not imported, so it inherits nothing.
externalSecrets: Environment "{{environment}}" reads {{names}} from the secret provider "{{provider}}". Imports never carry secret manager references, so each one is imported as an empty secret variable. Fill it in under Environments, or add a connection under Secret managers and pick the path with the key icon on its row; gostman run takes the value with --var.
brunoSecrets_one: The secret variable {{names}} has no value, because Bruno keeps secret values outside the collection files. Fill it in under Environments, or pass it to gostman run with --var.
brunoSecrets_other: The secret variables {{names}} have no value, because Bruno keeps secret values outside the collection files. Fill them in under Environments, or pass them to gostman run with --var.
dotEnv: "{{name}}" reads {{example}} from the collection's .env file, which is not imported. Add each value to an environment as a secret variable named process.env.NAME, or, in a folder workspace, copy .env next to gostman.yaml and keep it out of Git; gostman run on the Bruno folder reads it where it is.
openItemType: {{name}}: OpenCollection items of type "{{type}}" are not imported
unmappedTag: The Insomnia template tag "{{tag}}" has no Gostman equivalent and was kept as text in {{names}}.
liquidFilters: Template filters such as {{example}} have no Gostman equivalent and were kept as text in {{names}}.
fileTags: File tags in {{names}} now read {{example}}. A path must be inside the workspace folder, so copy the files there and fix the paths.
responseTags: Response tags now read the values that extract rules on {{names}} keep. Send the request a tag reads before the requests that use it: Insomnia sent it for you when the value was missing or old, Gostman does not.
insomniaSpec: The API spec of "{{name}}" is kept in the description of its folder. Save it as a file and import it to browse, lint, sync or mock it.
insomniaSpecFile: The API spec of "{{name}}" is the file {{file}}, which is not part of the export. Import that file to get its requests.
insomniaMock: The mock routes of "{{name}}" became requests with a saved example each, which Gostman's mock server serves.
insomniaVault_one: The vault secret {{names}} has no value, because Insomnia exports it encrypted. Fill it in under Environments, or pass it to gostman run with --var.
insomniaVault_other: The vault secrets {{names}} have no value, because Insomnia exports them encrypted. Fill them in under Environments, or pass them to gostman run with --var.
insomniaCookies: The cookie jar of "{{name}}" was not imported. Gostman keeps cookies on this computer and sets them from responses.
unitTestTarget: Unit test "{{suite}}" / "{{name}}" has no request in the import and was left out.
bufReflection: {{names}} loads its services from a Buf schema registry, which Gostman does not; add the .proto files or use server reflection.
socketIoArguments: {{names}} has Socket.IO messages with more than one argument. Gostman sends one argument, so only the first was kept.
oauthAudience: {{names}} sets an OAuth 2.0 audience, which Gostman does not send. Add it as a token request parameter on your provider if it needs one.
insomniaCertificates_one: "{{name}}" lists {{count}} CA certificate path, which were not imported. Add them under Network settings, or pass --cacert to gostman run.
insomniaCertificates_other: "{{name}}" lists {{count}} CA certificate paths, which were not imported. Add them under Network settings, or pass --cacert to gostman run.
